hints.title: Exact Duplicate Pairing
hints.text: Pair identical cards first to maximize total matched pairs directly.

hints.title: Prefix Sharing Consolidation
hints.text: For remaining singletons, group them by their initial character and pair within groups.

hints.title: Greedy Residual Pairing
hints.text: Sum the quotient of division by two across each shared character category.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def maxCardPairs(self, cards: List[str]) -> int:
        # Group cards by first letter and second letter
        first_group = Counter()
        for c in cards:
            first_group[c[0]] += 1
            
        # Maximum matching where pairs can share letters
        ans = 0
        counts = Counter(cards)
        
        # Exact duplicate pairs
        for card, cnt in list(counts.items()):
            ans += cnt // 2
            counts[card] %= 2
            
        # Match cards sharing the first letter
        by_first = Counter()
        for card, cnt in counts.items():
            if cnt > 0:
                by_first[card[0]] += cnt
                
        for ch, cnt in by_first.items():
            ans += cnt // 2
            
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Greedy pairing by identical string then by prefix character.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: General graph maximum matching is slower than greedy character grouping.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses frequency maps bounded by at most 26^2 entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Prioritize exact matches before grouping cards by prefix character.
